title: A comparison of the information conveyed by equity carve-outs, spin-offs, and asset sell-offs

rival_explanations: competitive considerations (rivals' loss reflects competition, not information)
economic efficiency argument (efficiency gains from restructuring)
efficiency gains explain the cross-type differences in rival returns
external financing choice generates differential wealth effects on parent rivals

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (corporate restructuring events; excludes financial institutions (SIC 6000-6999) and utilities (SIC 4900-4999))

data_sources.name: Standard and Poor's Register of Corporations
Wall Street Journal / Dow Jones News Wire reports (announcement dates); also Moody's and National Stock Summary

analyses.label: Table 1 - Descriptive information about firm size, offer size, and proportion of shares retained

key_ivs.name: type of restructuring
key_ivs.measure: equity carve-out, conventional IPO, spin-off, or asset sell-off
key_ivs.source: Mergers & Acquisitions transactions lists; Wall Street Journal / Dow Jones News Wire; CRSP

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: industry rivals with same four-digit SIC code as restructured subsidiary (carve-outs N=36, IPOs N=107, spin-offs N=41, sell-offs N=203)

dv.name: abnormal (excess) return to industry rivals
dv.measure: Two-day event return (0, 1); average excess returns in percent, computed as market-model prediction errors with estimation/pre-event period -240 to -121

key_ivs.name: type of restructuring announcement
key_ivs.measure: equity carve-out vs. conventional IPO vs. spin-off vs. asset sell-off; rivals identified by same four-digit SIC code as the restructured subsidiary

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: parent firms (carve-outs N=32, spin-offs N=37, sell-offs N=179)

dv.name: abnormal (excess) return to parent firms
dv.measure: Two-day event return (0, 1); average excess returns in percent from market-model prediction errors

key_ivs.name: type of restructuring announcement
key_ivs.measure: equity carve-out vs. spin-off vs. asset sell-off by the parent firm
key_ivs.source: Mergers & Acquisitions transactions lists; Wall Street Journal / Dow Jones News Wire; CRSP

analyses.label: Table 3, Panel B - Average excess returns to parent rival portfolios
analyses.sample: rivals of parent firms (carve-outs N=32, spin-offs N=28, sell-offs N=179)

dv.name: abnormal (excess) return to rivals of parent firms
dv.measure: Two-day event return (0, 1); average excess returns in percent, equally weighted rival portfolios per event

analyses.label: [withheld: wording matches the source]
analyses.sample: industry rivals of equity carve-outs and conventional IPOs

dv.name: change in industry-rival equity beta
dv.measure: difference between calculated post-event equity betas and estimation-period equity betas for industry rivals (t-test of the difference)

key_ivs.name: unseasoned equity issuance (going-public) event
key_ivs.measure: equity carve-out vs. conventional IPO announcement
key_ivs.source: CRSP; Mergers & Acquisitions transactions lists; Wall Street Journal

analyses.label: Size-based subsamples - larger vs. smaller units for carve-outs and spin-offs (difference in means)

dv.name: abnormal (excess) return to industry rivals
dv.measure: Two-day average excess return in percent to rivals of the restructured unit

analyses.label: Sell-off parents disaggregated by retention of proceeds

dv.name: abnormal (excess) return to parent firms
dv.measure: Two-day average excess return in percent to sell-off parent firms

key_ivs.name: retention of sell-off proceeds
key_ivs.measure: sellers that do not retain the proceeds (N=50) vs. sellers that retain the proceeds (N=129)

analyses.label: General restructuring announcements - parent firms and their rivals
analyses.sample: 38 general restructuring announcements by parent firms and their rivals
